sources.title: Natural Earth 1:10m rivers and lakes, retained v5.1.2 release

access_metadata.source_date: 2022 release; observations composite, not a dated survey
access_metadata.geometry: Source River and Lake Centerline; Lake and Alkaline Lake polygons. Reservoir polygons excluded.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern generalised reference. River axes through regulated reaches are not reconstructed 1900 channels. Natural lake levels, deltas and banks may differ.

value.uncertainty: Modern geographic reference; line width is cartographic, not surveyed river width. No 1900 water level, navigation or transport assertion.

source_notes.epoch_qualification: Broad composite catalogue interval, not exact observation dates
source_notes.historical_channel: Unconfirmed where modern regulation changed the course

facts.methodology: Actual source geometry; metric simplification, core clipping and two cartographic line weights; no endpoints joined across gaps.
